Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje industriale
Job Responsibilities
Take charge of the full customs clearance process for factory import and export, coordinate customs declaration, document review, tariff and compliance declaration in Romania and EU, and control clearance lead time and risks.
Liaise with customs authorities, freight forwarders, customs brokers, overseas suppliers and logistics carriers; maintain cooperative channels and handle emergencies such as customs inspections, cargo detentions and tariff disputes.
Develop logistics plans for imported raw materials and finished goods for export, arrange road/multimodal transportation, track in-transit shipments and manage logistics costs.
Maintain import & export records, keep customs documents, certificates of origin, CE certificates and other trade paperwork to ensure full traceability and compliance with customs audit requirements.
Monitor updates of EU customs regulations and local Romanian trade policies, align internal teams, and implement requirements on trade compliance, anti-dumping measures and rules of origin.
 Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or above in International Trade, Logistics, Supply Chain or related disciplines, with at least 3 years of working experience in import & export customs clearance and logistics management in Romania or the EU.
Well-versed in Romanian customs rules, EU tariff regime, rules of origin and anti-dumping policies; proficient in practical procedures including customs declaration, T1 transit and bonded operations.
Good command of English for business communication and proficient in office software; Romanian language skills are preferred.
Strong troubleshooting capability, able to independently resolve complex issues including cargo detention, customs audits and tariff calculation.
Meticulous and responsible, with strong awareness of cost control and compliance; experience in construction machinery or manufacturing plants is preferred.
